PluginData.Author: Cheezecake
PluginData.Tooltip: Early access: play Space Engineers in a VR headset, with your hands, through OpenXR.
PluginData.Description:
EARLY ACCESS. Play Space Engineers 1 in a PC VR headset. The game's own renderer draws each eye, through OpenXR: no VorpX, ReShade or other injector.
- Tools sit in your hands and aim where you point; hold rifles and tools with both hands - Hold the stick and throttle to fly; press buttons with a fingertip; grab seats, doors and terminals to use them - Climb along hulls and ladders by hand; open your helmet by gripping it - Tools wheel, actions wheel, a wrist panel, and your suit status on your wrist - Standing or seated play, with height calibration; dynamic resolution
To start: connect the headset first, start the game with Pulsar's Legacy launcher, and hold the left Menu button to recentre. Settings are in Options > VR.
Early access: tested only on a Quest 3 over Meta Link (cable) with an RTX 3060. Other OpenXR headsets and runtimes should work but are untested; Vive wands have their own layout, not yet tried on real wands. Meta advises that NVIDIA drivers newer than 591.86 can make Link freeze.
Controls, known issues and bug reports: https://github.com/cheezecake-dev/CheezecakeSEVR
A separate project, not related to Math0424's earlier SpaceEngineersVR plugin.
